Uśanas
Śukra.
--on arthaśāstra. See Mahābhārata an. Kauṭalya's Arthaśāstra. See Śukranīti. See also Kane, HDS. I. p.. 110-1; Proceed AIOC. III. Madras, 1924, p. 3. JBORS. X. Intro., Rājanītiratnākara; Presidential Address, AIOC. XXIst Session, Srinagar, p.. 24-6.
--on dhanurveda. Q. in Lakṣaṇaprakāśa [Page400-a. of Mitramiśra. See also Kavīndrācārya 2158.
--on dharmaśāstra. See below U. dharmaśāstra, U. saṁhitā, U. smṛti.

Uśanas
or auzanasa smRti or dharmazAstra Br. Mus. 179. MD. 2623. This is Śāṇḍilyasmṛti on Pāñcarātra, text same a. MD. 2723.

Uśanas-nīti
Mithilā. For Uśanas q.s on Nīti, see Kane, HDS. I. p. 110; also under Śukranīti.

Uśanah2smṛti,_U._Dharmaśāstra,_Auśanasasmṛti,_Au._Dha._Śā.
Current in three texts, one in prose in 7 chs. interspersed with verses; an. two in verses, one short version in 51 verses, an. another, long, in 9 chs. Some of the verses in the prose text occur in the metrical texts too; of Uśanas q.s in many Smṛtis an. Nibandhas, in prose an. verse, some are found in the above three texts, an. some in none. See Kane, HDS. I. p.. 110-6.
--details of version not known.

--short metrical text in 51 verses on Jātīvṛttivibhāga, on pratiloma offsprings, their caste an. occupations. Text ptd. in Ānandāsrama 48, p.. 46-8 an. in Jīvānanda's D.. śāstrasaṁgraha, Calcutta, 1876, p.. 497-9. Alwar 1273. Bik. 1048. Bikaner 1415. 1416. C.. II. 9. IO. 1315. Jodhpur 558.

Text ptd. in Dutt's Dharma Sastra Texts, Vol. I. p.. 111-164 in 9 chs. an. called U. saṁhitā; also Jīvānanda's D.. śāstrasaṅgraha, Calcutta 1876; Eng. transl. by same editor, Calcutta 1906, Vol. I. p.. 189-267. Uṣāniruddha

Uṣāniruddhacarita
mentioned in the list of works of Kumāratātācārya (Śrīśaila Śatakratu etc.) an. his sons in his son's Kumāratātayārya-vaibhavaprakāśikā, ptd. Grantha script, Kumbhakonam, p. 4, śl. 48.

Uṣāniruddhanāṭaka
by a king of Kāśī named Lakṣmīnātha. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 52.

Uṣāniruddhīya
kāvya in 9 cantos. by Viśvanātha (Col. Digubbapadavīraṭa-Viśvanātha ?). GD. 1690. Granthappura p. 83. no. 1690 (1-9 sargas). TCD. 1408.

Uṣāpariṇaya

Uṣāpariṇaya

Uṣāpariṇaya

Pt.. TSS. 179, 1956.

Uṣāpariṇaya
a drama in 7 acts, by Guṇḍu Rāmasvāmi Śāstrī, son of Rāmabrahma. [Page401-b]
Pt.. Velangi, Cocanada, 1910. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 868.

Uṣāpariṇaya
nāṭaka. by Śrīnivāsācārya. Rice 256. C.. the entry before the previous.

Uṣābhilāṣa
a musical poem intended for dance a. the festival in Pūri. by Nārāyaṇa of 18th century. See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa, 1963, p. 551; also J. of the Madras Music Academy, IV. p. 76.

Uṣābhilāṣa

See Proceed. AIOC. XVIII. Annamalainagar, 1955. p. 176.

Uṣāharaṇa

Uṣāharaṇa

Uṣāharaṇa

Uṣāharaṇa
